dial_waiting: Outgoing calls arrive with the phone channel, which is not built yet. The keypad is here so the shape of the screen is settled before it is.
empty_body: Put the chat widget on your website from the Channels tab in settings. The first visitor who writes appears here, stored and searchable, as they type.
error_body: The interface is running, but the server refused the request. Check that it is up and that the database it reads from is accepting connections, then reload.
offline_body: The interface is running, but it got no answer from Tel-Agent. Anything below was last read before the connection went.
today_none: Nothing has come in yet today
waiting_body: Each one needs a person. They are in the notifications tray, oldest first.
waiting_many: {count} things are waiting on a decision
waiting_one: 1 thing is waiting on a decision
